title: TOCTOU: messages lost from queryChanges between two store locks
description: In MessageQueryChangesHandler, lock 1 collects chat_added and releases the mutex; lock 2 re-acquires it to read new_state and compute positions. Any message inserted between the two lock acquisitions has state_version > old counter and therefore appears in new_state (s-N) but is absent from chat_added. The client receives newQueryState=s-N with an incomplete added list. On the next queryChanges call using s-N as sinceQueryState, those messages are no longer > s-N so they are permanently dropped. Messages are silently lost from the client view.
